salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-zhipu. I Think, Therefore I Attack (arXiv 2611.08811v1), a SECURITY study (thought-injection attacks): FLAG safety/bias, not capability. Study 1: GLM-5.3-Flash (Table II + pooled 8.6% leak rate, from b-zhipu). Study 2: GLM-5.2 cells of Tables IV (attack success rate) and V (final response without mention of the injection), 12 + 12 cells (c-zhipu). Table III (leak locations) is not a score. Cells of the other models (Qwen, MiniMax) belong to other lots.
